1.text: Nuko rero mwana wanjye, ukomerere mu buntu bubonerwa muri Kristo Yesu,

2.text: kandi ibyo wanyumvanye imbere y'abahamya benshi, ubimenyeshe abantu bo kwizerwa bazashobora kubyigisha abandi.

3.text: Ujye ufatanya nanjye kwihanganira imibabaro, nk'uko bikwiriye umusirikare mwiza wa Kristo Yesu.

4.text: Nta waba umusirikare kandi ngo yishyire mu by'ubu bugingo, ngo abe akinejeje uwamwandikiye ubusirikare.

5.text: Kandi iyo umuntu ashatse kurushanwa mu mikino ntahabwa ikamba, keretse arushanijwe nk'uko bitegetswe.

6.text: Umuhinzi uhinga ni we ukwiriye kubanza kwenda ku mbuto.

7.text: Zirikana ibyo mvuze, kuko Umwami wacu azaguha ubwenge muri byose.

8.text: Ujye wibuka Yesu Kristo wakomotse mu rubyaro rwa Dawidi, akazuka mu bapfuye nk'uko ubutumwa nahawe buvuga,

9.text: ubwo ndenganyirizwa ndetse nkaboheshwa iminyururu nk'umugome, nyamara ijambo ry'Imana ryo ntiribohwa n'iminyururu.

10.text: Ni cyo gituma nihanganira byose ku bw'intore z'Imana, kugira ngo na zo zibone agakiza kabonerwa muri Kristo Yesu gafatanije n'ubwiza buhoraho.

11.text: Iri jambo ni iryo kwizerwa ngo “Niba twarapfanye na we tuzabanaho na we,

12.text: kandi nitwihangana tuzīmana na we, naho nitumwihakana na we azatwihakana,

13.text: kandi nubwo tutizera we ahora ari uwo kwizerwa, kuko atabasha kwivuguruza.”

14.text: Ujye ubibutsa ibyo, ubihanangiririze imbere y'Imana ko bareka kurwanira amagambo kuko ari nta cyo bimaze, ahubwo bigusha abumva.

15.text: Ujye ugira umwete wo kwishyira Imana nk'ushimwa, umukozi udakwiriye kugira ipfunwe, ukwiriranya neza ijambo ry'ukuri.

16.text: Ariko amagambo y'amanjwe atari ay'Imana uyazibukire, kuko abayavuga bazarushaho gushayisha,

17.text: kandi ijambo ryabo rizaryana nk'igisebe cy'umufunzo. Muri abo ni Humenayo na Fileto,

18.text: kuko bayobye bakava mu kuri bavuga ko umuzuko wamaze kubaho, bakubika kwizera kwa bamwe.

19.text: Nyamara urufatiro rukomeye rw'Imana ruracyahagaze, rwanditsweho iki kimenyetso ngo “Uwiteka azi abe”, kandi ngo “Umuntu wese uvuga izina ry'Uwiteka ave mu bidatunganye.”

20.text: Mu nzu y'inyumba ntihabamo ibintu by'izahabu n'iby'ifeza gusa, ahubwo habamo n'iby'ibiti n'iby'ibumba, kandi bimwe babikoresha iby'icyubahiro, naho ibindi bakabikoresha ibiteye isoni.

21.text: Nuko rero umuntu niyiyeza akitandukanya n'ibidatunganye, azaba abaye ikintu cyo gukoreshwa iby'icyubahiro cyejejwe, kigirira nyiracyo umumaro kandi cyatunganirijwe imirimo myiza yose.

22.text: Nuko uhunge irari rya gisore, ahubwo ukurikize gukiranuka no kwizera n'urukundo n'amahoro, ufatanije n'abambaza Umwami wacu bafite imitima iboneye.

23.text: Nyamara ibibazo by'ubupfu n'iby'abaswa ntukabyemere, uzi nawe ko bibyara amahane.

24.text: Ariko umugaragu w'Umwami wacu ntakwiriye kuba umunyamahane, ahubwo akwiriye kugira ineza kuri bose, agakunda kwigisha, akihangana,

25.text: agahanisha ubugwaneza abamugisha impaka ngo ahari nibishoboka, Imana ibahe kwihana ngo bamenye ukuri,

26.text: basinduke bave mu mutego wa Satani wabafashe mpiri, babone gukora ibyo Imana ishaka.
